| `value`        | `union`                                                                                                  |          | `null`  | Current selection (v-model) — the catalogue's emitted value (path / name / …), a URL, or null.                                                                                                                               |
| `icons`        | `Array<{key: string, label: string, value: string, search?: string, path?: string, component?: object}>` |          | `[]`    | The icon catalogue to browse: `[{ key, label, value, search?, path?, component? }]`. Build with \{@link mdiCatalogue\} / \{@link vmdiCatalogue\}. When empty, an injected `cnIconCatalogue` or the curated fallback is used. |
| `urlIcons`     | `Array<{ label: string, url: string }>`                                                                  |          | `[]`    | Curated image-URL icons for the Custom tab. Each renders as an `&lt;img&gt;` and emits its `url` when picked.                                                                                                                |
| `uploadFn`     | `union`                                                                                                  |          | `null`  | Injected upload transport: `async (dataUrl) =&gt; ({ url })`. | `maxResults`   | `number`                                                                                                 |          | `150`   | Maximum number of icon cells rendered in the grid at once. Keeps the DOM small; a hint is shown when matches exceed the cap.                                                                                                 |
| `defaultIcons` | `string[]`                                                                                               |          | `[]`    | Catalogue `key`s to show when the search box is empty. | `inline`       | `boolean`                                                                                                |          | `false` | Render the picker panel inline (always open) instead of the default trigger-button-plus-popover. | `showLabels`   | `boolean`                                                                                                |          | `false` | Show the human-readable label under each icon cell.                                                                                                                                                                          |
| `allowUrl`     | `boolean`                                                                                                |          | `false` | Offer a free-text image-URL input on the Custom tab, so the picker can also hold an arbitrary URL (the icon-or-URL fields). Off by default.                                                                                  |
| `label`        | `string`                                                                                                 |          | `''`    | Optional field label rendered above the control.
